rows.label: tlk70000043_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Eek... I thought I was dead
about a hundred times!

rows.label: tlk70000043_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Just thinking about it chills my
bones! The capital could have been
completely destroyed in the attack!

rows.label: tlk70000043_02_msg0003
rows.name:
I'm glad that the legendary Iiran
cooking didn't get wiped from
the history books for good!

rows.label: tlk70000043_02_msg0004
rows.name:
I can't accept that! Iira's mature,
delicate food culture absolutely must
be preserved for future generations!

rows.label: tlk70000043_02_msg0005
rows.name:
If that's what it takes, I'll do
anything!

rows.label: tlk70000043_02_msg0006
rows.name:
I'm only one man, but as a
food researcher, I'll carry
on fighting to the bitter end!
